items.name: Product Hunt
items.cost: Free submission
items.next_action: Launch is live. Monitor ranking, upvotes, comments and featuring; respond to meaningful engagement.

items.name: Uneed
items.cost: Paid submission completed
items.next_action: Launch scheduled for 2026-09-15. No duplicate submission; prepare launch-day follow-up.
items.notes: Submission and payment completed; launch scheduled for 15 September 2026.

items.name: SaaSHub
items.cost: Free submission used; $75 Priority+ explicitly declined
items.evidence: Authenticated SaaSHub management page shows TryToolScout, Pending approval, and an estimated review time of up to 32 days.
items.next_action: Wait for free editorial review; add accurate logo/screenshots later if existing truthful assets become available. Never buy Priority+.
items.notes: Duplicate avoided: a submission already existed in the pcaiano account. Public candidate URL is not yet an approved live listing.

items.name: AlternativeTo
items.cost: Free community backlog used; $5 priority review explicitly declined
items.evidence: Authenticated owner-only page states 'Your submission is waiting to be reviewed', displays the canonical website, Pedro Caiano, Portugal, Online, Free/Proprietary, the public Product Hunt icon and screenshot, and records SaaSHub, AlternativeTo and Product Hunt as suggested alternatives.
items.blocker: Editorial review may take a few months. The page is visible only to the owner until approval and must not be shared as a live public listing.
items.next_action: Wait for the free editorial review notification and verify public visibility after approval. Never pay $5 to move it to the front of the queue.

items.name: Peerlist Launchpad
items.cost: Free
items.evidence: Launchpad is active for week 36 and accepts launches, but the connected browser has no Peerlist profile/session.
items.blocker: Create or sign in to a truthful personal Peerlist profile.
items.next_action: Owner signs in or creates the profile; then automation completes and submits the free ToolScout launch.

items.name: MicroLaunch
items.cost: Free launch route; premium upsell excluded
items.evidence: Current site exposes New Launch and Signup alongside a separate Go Premium option.
items.blocker: Sign in or create a free maker account; accurate logo and screenshots are also required for a strong submission.
items.next_action: Owner authenticates; automation uses only New Launch/free route and declines Premium.

items.name: Fazier
items.cost: Basic is €0 but requires a backlink badge on ToolScout homepage or footer; paid tiers start at $29
items.evidence: Current pricing page states Basic Free, review within 30 days, and a mandatory Fazier backlink on the product homepage or footer.
items.blocker: The only €0 route requires a site-wide reciprocal-link placement, which is not justified by current evidence and would alter the public product.
items.next_action: Skip unless the owner later explicitly approves the reciprocal badge after measurable value review. Never buy Lite, Premium or Super.

items.name: BetaList
items.cost: Free submission path requires account; no paid option selected
items.evidence: Submission URL redirects to BetaList sign-in and offers X, email/password, or magic-link authentication.
items.blocker: Sign in or create a BetaList account.
items.next_action: Owner authenticates; automation verifies current free eligibility for an already-live product before submitting.

submission_pack.tagline: Find the right software for the job — without the noise.
submission_pack.short_description: ToolScout is an independent software discovery and recommendation platform that turns a buyer's workflow and intent into a focused shortlist of relevant tools, with transparent comparisons and no pay-to-rank recommendations.
submission_pack.audience: Small businesses, consultants, agencies, creators, sales and marketing teams, and software buyers.
submission_pack.differentiator: Intent-driven recommendations rather than a generic directory. Affiliate relationships never influence ranking.
